sources.fact: 2021 Help describes spline placement in a 3D sketch and Tab to switch planes while creating it.
The 2021 3D spline panel exposes existing relations, point XYZ coordinates, tangent controls, reset and Relax Spline.
2021 Help describes relations on 3D spline handles, axis alignment and relations across sketch planes.
Control polygon nodes may be moved and XYZ set; Relax Spline can smooth an edited curve.

symptoms: A dragged point or handle moves a 3D spline unexpectedly in depth or alters nearby curvature.
The spline changes shape or appears discontinuous after control polygon edits.
A spline point/handle will not move as expected, or solver status indicates constraints.
rivals: Point or control handle is constrained by existing 3D sketch relations.
An unintended active placement plane or XYZ coordinate is responsible for apparent out-of-plane motion.
Tangent handle weighting, direction or internal continuity controls rather than the selected point govern curvature.
A control polygon edit changes multiple spline spans and needs re-parameterisation or deliberate smoothness constraints.

probes.test: Select the spline in the active 3D sketch, open 3D Spline PropertyManager, inspect Existing Relations and select each relation to highlight affected geometry; record Fully/Under Defined status.
probes.conditions: 2021 3D sketch, active document/configuration, read UI values only; no changes required; record point/handle and named relations.
probes.rivals: Constraint-driven movement versus free point/handle curvature edits.
probes.basis: DOCUMENTED: 3D Spline PropertyManager and Sketch Relations in 3D Sketches.
probes.member: not applicable: UI-only procedure; no API member asserted

outcomes.observation: A relation highlights the moved point/handle or external entity
outcomes.meaning: Constraint is a supported candidate for the unexpected motion.
outcomes.limits: Highlighting alone does not prove solver causality.
outcomes.next_step: On a disposable copy selectively suppress/remove that relation and compare.

outcomes.observation: No relevant relation highlights and spline is under-defined
outcomes.meaning: Simple relation lock is less likely.
outcomes.limits: Unshown constraints, handle weighting and plane selection remain possible.
outcomes.next_step: Inspect XYZ coordinates, tangent properties and placement plane.

outcomes.observation: Inconclusive: spline panel or relation highlight cannot be obtained
outcomes.meaning: Cannot determine relation constraints from this test.
outcomes.next_step: Verify entity type and open the intended 3D sketch.

probes.test: For the affected spline point, read its X/Y/Z values and intended plane; in a disposable test sketch change only one coordinate or recreate a point with explicit plane switching, comparing projected views.
probes.conditions: 3D sketch; same coordinate system; XYZ values in model length units (record mm); creation-plane switching uses Tab; editing must be on a disposable copy.
probes.rivals: Actual depth/plane change versus view projection or spline-handle effect.
probes.basis: DOCUMENTED: Creating 3D Splines and 3D Spline PropertyManager; diagnosis is a hypothesis.
probes.member: not applicable: UI-only procedure; no API member asserted

outcomes.observation: Z or another out-of-plane coordinate changes with the unexpected motion
outcomes.limits: Does not identify which relation or action caused it.
outcomes.next_step: Check relation highlights and active reference geometry.

outcomes.observation: XYZ coordinates are unchanged but curvature appears different
outcomes.meaning: Point displacement is unlikely to explain the difference.
outcomes.limits: Handle direction, view projection or changes elsewhere remain possible.
outcomes.next_step: Inspect tangent and control polygon controls.

outcomes.observation: Inconclusive: coordinate reference or selected point cannot be matched
outcomes.limits: Do not infer the curve moved in XYZ.
outcomes.next_step: Identify point index and reference system before retesting.

probes.test: On disposable copy, record tangent weighting/radial/polar direction and internal-continuity setting; change one handle control at a time, then try Reset This Handle or Relax Spline and compare curvature combs.
probes.conditions: Same 3D sketch and point index, record controls and display curvature; modifying handles/relaxing spline changes geometry and may affect dependent features.
probes.rivals: Tangent-control curvature versus control-polygon placement or constraint effects.
probes.basis: DOCUMENTED: 3D Spline PropertyManager and Using Control Polygons; downstream shape prediction is a hypothesis.
probes.member: not applicable: UI-only procedure; no API member asserted

outcomes.observation: Curvature becomes smooth after Reset Handle or Relax Spline
outcomes.meaning: Supports handle/parameterisation sensitivity as a mechanism.
outcomes.limits: Does not prove the resulting curve satisfies design tolerance or downstream feature constraints.
outcomes.next_step: Quantify curvature/tangent mismatch and rebuild only in disposable test.

outcomes.observation: Curvature anomaly remains with controls reset
outcomes.meaning: Weakens one-handle adjustment as complete explanation.
outcomes.limits: Point positions and relations can still impose the shape.
outcomes.next_step: Inspect point coordinates, relations and control polygon nodes.

outcomes.observation: Inconclusive: control is unavailable or edited spline differs in other respects
outcomes.meaning: No valid inference about the original cause.
outcomes.limits: Unavailable controls do not imply they are unimportant.
outcomes.next_step: Document entity and active controls for separate reproduction.

limitations: No API access is inferred from UI features; no spline API member was claimed.
A smooth-looking spline does not establish design tolerances, curvature continuity or successful downstream sweep.
No installed SOLIDWORKS runtime tests were performed.
